disposition: Retired obsolete test releases. Owner approved deletion of these four release records and their 26 uploaded assets. Git tags and source history are retained. This archive preserves descriptions and public asset metadata, not executable bytes. Original release/download URLs below are historical and are expected to stop serving after cleanup.
reason: 1.9.16/17 had a known native-admission/preload blocker; 1.9.18/19 did not complete installed-upgrade acceptance. Superseded by the separate test-updater-1.9.8-20261017 reference and formal v1.9.8 release.
preserved: all other releases and third-party source materials
workflow: The main branch legacy updater-installed-acceptance workflow is retired with an unconditional false job guard. Its old frozen-inputs record remains historical, not runnable download guidance. This does not modify current test or release branches.
dependencyNotes: v1.9.19 referred to the v1.9.18 combined notice ZIP and distribution notes; both releases are retired together.
v1.9.16/17 historical frozen-inputs referenced their installer and notice URLs.
Existing v1.9.4/v1.9.5 third-party corresponding-source/material archives remain untouched.

releases.name: LuckyRay 1.9.19 TEST ONLY — upgrade acceptance incomplete
releases.body:
# LuckyRay 1.9.19 — TEST ONLY, not Latest

This is the unchanged frozen B19 installer for isolated updater acceptance.
The A18 → B19 immediate and scheduled installed upgrade chains remain **not
accepted / pending**. Publishing these attachments is not a successful upgrade
test or a stable release. Do not replace a daily-use installation for testing.

- Corresponding public product source:
  [57c0dcab8c9534976b0b97a45380ec379c573eed](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/commit/57c0dcab8c9534976b0b97a45380ec379c573eed).
- Installer SHA-256:
  `099c1a3da14d955236acaad532b36d67a021d6a68ccdf25f16c8be733b24477d`.
- The existing official updater signature is supplied unchanged. This installer
  is **not Windows Authenticode signed**; updater signatures and Windows signing
  are different. Do not bypass OS security prompts.
- The five attachments are the frozen installer, its signature, public input
  record, test manifest and checksums. `TEST-UPDATE-MANIFEST.json` is only a test
  attachment, **not** production `latest.json`.
- Exact-version third-party notices are included inside the installer. Shared
  supplementary materials are already available with A18 and are reused here:
  [notice ZIP](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.18/LuckyRay-1.9.18-1.9.19-third-party-notices.zip)
  (SHA-256 `b1270c7d098f2a95cbce2fc11bd39a246f819220306afa4c7edf2d447ba984d9`)
  and [distribution notes](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.18/DISTRIBUTION-NOTES-A18-B19.md).

This upload does not rebuild or re-sign either package, run tests, change source,
update the website, move Latest or switch the production update feed.

releases.name: LuckyRay 1.9.18 TEST ONLY — upgrade acceptance pending
releases.body:
# TEST ONLY — repaired updater acceptance candidates, not stable

This non-latest pre-release is for isolated Windows updater acceptance with
synthetic data. **Neither independent repaired installed chain is accepted yet.**
It does not change the website, stable download, Latest Release or production
`latest.json`. Do not install it over a daily-use installation for testing.

Repaired pair: A **1.9.18** → B **1.9.19**. The first A16 installed attempt failed
before update discovery because generated runtime records and three native
compile-time hashes were inconsistent. The original integrity checks correctly
refused startup. A16/B17 remain unchanged historical test assets with a known
blocker; these new candidates synchronize the exact record pins and add normal
build and original-native-admission gates. Official LSH remains 0.1.7-rc.2.

The packages include exact-version Deno 2.9.4 / V8 and SeaHash 4.1.0 notices, the
formal exact-hash upstream CI-config exclusion, and corrected independent MIT
license metadata. Original license texts and third-party rights are preserved.
See the accompanying distribution notes and notice indexes for scope/provenance,
including the explicit treatment of original archives without a standalone
license file. LuckyRay's MIT does not relicense third-party components.

Each candidate's exact installer size/SHA-256, corresponding public product
source and signature verification identity are in `PUBLIC-TEST-INPUT.json` and
`SHA256SUMS.txt`. `TEST-UPDATE-MANIFEST.json` is a test attachment, **not** a
production feed. The unchanged official updater key verifies installer
signatures; the installers are **not Windows Authenticode signed**. Do not bypass
OS security prompts.

The combined new notice ZIP and `DISTRIBUTION-NOTES-A18-B19.md` accompany both
candidates. Existing unchanged media corresponding-source/build materials remain
available separately, with their original exact versions and scope:

- [Desktop third-party materials](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.4/LuckyRay-1.9.4-third-party-materials.zip)
  SHA-256 `055418e72a27e83592545a63fa95930c2b2223cd2f1f0c25ba2ba2eb58fa06a0`.
- [Desktop third-party supplement](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.4/LuckyRay-1.9.4-desktop-third-party-supplement.zip)
  SHA-256 `bf84f934be36d0ad19b912e31c3ee9f48307fc9cedb0af810a1e976f7c130a45`.

This includes the GPL media-suite boundary and corresponding source/patch/build
materials; it is not a claim that every media component is LGPL. Collector stays
1.9.6 and the optional Community MCP component stays 0.1.1; no automatic browser
extension installation/update or broader codec/model compatibility is claimed.

Immediate and scheduled installed upgrade results will be linked after actual
independent runs. Source CI, static extraction or component tests alone are not a
real installed upgrade pass. Real IME and the unchanged live production feed are
not proven by a controlled disposable HTTPS test environment.

releases.name: LuckyRay 1.9.17 TEST ONLY — known preload blocker
releases.body:
> **KNOWN BLOCKER / DO NOT USE AS A RELEASE CANDIDATE:** The first real installed
> acceptance run stopped before update discovery because the generated runtime
> records and three native compile-time record hashes were inconsistent. LSH
> correctly refused startup. Neither continuous upgrade chain is accepted for
> these bytes. The native admission check remains strict; a corrected immutable
> candidate pair is being prepared. These historical test assets are retained
> unchanged, not silently replaced. Stable downloads and the production feed
> are unaffected.


# TEST ONLY — signed updater acceptance candidates

仅供隔离 Windows 自动升级验收，**不是稳定版，不是 Latest，不进入正式更新源**。
请勿覆盖日常安装、Main 或真实资料。候选使用正式应用标识与更新信任；本轮
仅在独立一次性测试机中建立合成资料和授权。升级验收完成之前，不宣称正式发布。

Test-only, non-latest Windows updater inputs. Do not install over a daily copy
or real profile. Two independent continuous installed chains are required;
source checks, package signatures and static inspection are not substitutes.

## Candidate changes

- Precisely omit an upstream debug2.6.9 coverage-service CI configuration during
  formal staging. Original runtime source/entrypoints and LSH0.1.7-rc.2 remain.
  Existing exact integrity, native-module and resolver checks remain mandatory.
- Bundle version-bound Deno2.9.4/V8150.2.0 native/transitive notices and the
  original same-version SeaHash4.1.0 license omission correction. Preserve
  existing copyright/licensing and corresponding-source obligations.
- Reuse the existing safe save/LSH retirement, inherited install language and
  automatic reopen implementation for real upgrade acceptance. No new UI or
  unrelated feature is introduced.

Installer update signatures use the existing approved Minisign/Tauri trust.
**Windows Authenticode: NotSigned.** Update signing is not Windows code signing.
No production private key is uploaded. The public update feed, stable release,
website and existing signed A14/B15 historical candidates are unchanged.

## Required unchanged third-party source materials

The following exact public archives remain applicable only to the unchanged
components documented by the candidate inventory. Keep them with redistributed
copies, alongside the new bundled notice supplement:

- [Runtime/media/LibreOffice materials](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.4/LuckyRay-1.9.4-third-party-materials.zip)
  — SHA-256 `055418e72a27e83592545a63fa95930c2b2223cd2f1f0c25ba2ba2eb58fa06a0`.
- [Desktop dependency/source supplement](https://github.com/xiaorui2886/LuckyRay/releases/download/v1.9.4/LuckyRay-1.9.4-desktop-third-party-supplement.zip)
  — SHA-256 `bf84f934be36d0ad19b912e31c3ee9f48307fc9cedb0af810a1e976f7c130a45`.

The FFmpeg tool/DLL suite has GPL-3.0-or-later scope, with its original LGPL and
dependency texts, exact corresponding-source index, patches, build and relink
materials retained. This does not relabel the independent LuckyRay host. MPL
source availability and original third-party license rights remain unchanged.

Collector1.9.6 and optional Community MCP0.1.1 are unchanged and not repackaged
or automatically enabled by this desktop candidate.

## Notice index clarification

Keep the attached `LICENSE-CLARIFICATION-A16-B17.md` with these candidates.
For wasmparser0.244.0 the exact original OR grant independently permits MIT;
the informational index accidentally appends an unnecessary LLVM-exception
label to that choice. Full original grant/attribution and MIT text are present.
The separate clarification makes the actual MIT choice explicit without
changing any frozen installer/signature or original third-party rights.
